title: 第13章 留客伏计
content_zh:
傍晚，大雨止了，三警员道了搅扰别过，温文新送出门外。

    那破衣乞丐携了男孩的手也准备告辞，温老太向那男孩瞧了一眼，想起他怒斥方玲时正气凛然的神情，心想：“这小小孩童，居然有此胆识，倒也少见。”问道：“两位要上何处？路费可够用了？”乞丐说：“我们兄弟二人流落江湖，四海为家，说不上往哪里去。”温老太向那孩童细**量，沉吟：“两位若不嫌弃，就在这儿帮忙干些活。咱们堡大，也不争多两口人吃饭。”那乞丐心中另有打算，一听大喜，当即上前拜谢。温老太问起姓名，乞丐自称叫王辉，那男孩是他弟弟，叫作王庚。

    当晚王辉和王庚兄弟俩由管家分派，住在西偏院旁的一间小屋中。二人关上门窗，王辉丑陋的脸上满是喜色，低声说：“少侠，你过世的爸妈保佑，这两张秘籍终于回到你手上。真是老天爷有眼。”王庚说：“大哥，你千万别再叫我‘少侠’，一个不慎给人听见了，平白惹人疑心。”王辉连声称是，从怀中掏出那油纸小包，双手恭恭敬敬递给王庚。他倒不是对这男孩尊重恭敬，却是想起了遗下两页秘籍的那位恩人。

    王庚问：“大哥，你跟那个曹虎说了几句什么话，他就心甘情愿交还了秘籍？”王辉说：“我说：‘你撕去的两页秘籍呢？秦大侠叫你还出来！’就这么两句话。那时秦大侠便在他眼前，这是千载难逢的良机，他就有天大的胆子，也不敢不还。”王庚沉吟一会问：“这两页秘籍为什么在他那里？你为什么叫我记着他的相貌？他为什么见了秦大侠这样害怕？”

    王辉不答，一张脸抽搐得更加难看，泪水在眼眶中滚来滚去，强忍着不让掉下。王庚说：“大哥，我不问啦。你说过等我长大了，学成了武功，再原原本本地说给我听。我这就好好地学。”

    于是兄弟俩在温家堡定居了下来。王辉在菜园中挑粪种菜，王庚在练武厅里扫地抹枪。岳胜在温家堡养伤，闲着就和儿女、温文新三人讲论拳脚。他们在演武练拳的当儿，王庚偶然瞧上一眼，但绝不多看。

    他们知道这男孩很大胆，却从没想到他身有武功，因此当他偶尔看一眼的时候，不论是有数十年江湖经历的岳胜，还是聪明机警的温文新，从来不曾疑心过他是在留意拳法的奥妙。但他绝不是偷学武艺。他心中所转的念头，岳胜他们更加想不到了。因为每当他看了他们所说的奇招妙招后总想：“那有什么了不起？这样的招数，只好用来跟蠢材笨蛋胡混瞎缠，又怎打得倒英雄好汉？”

    因为这男孩其实叫闵嘉庚，是闵恩仇的儿子，就是那位在天竺山大顶峰和秦英豪大战了五天不分胜负的闵刀王。因为他父亲遗给他记载着武林绝学的一本《北斗秘籍》。

    这本秘籍本来少了开篇两页，缺了扎根基的入门功夫，缺了总诀纲领，于是不论他多么聪明用功，总不能入门，练来练去始终不对头。现下机缘巧合，给曹虎偷去的总诀找回来了，本来碰得焦头烂额拼命也走不通的处所，突然变成坦途大道，武功进境一日千里。

    曹虎凭着学自两页纸的寥寥十余怪招，便能称雄武林，连岳胜也败在他手下。闵嘉庚却从头至尾学全了。当然，他年纪还小，功力还浅，许多精微之处还不了解。但凭着这本秘籍，他练一天抵得上温文新、周银兵他们练几年。

    何况，即使他们练上三五十年，也不会学到这天下绝艺。这《北斗秘籍》乃是武学瑰宝，闵家高手都会将自己的武功心得写进其中，剑法、刀法、长武器、短武器、软武器、掌法、拳法、腿法、暗器、轻功等等，实是包罗万有。更有几页乃是记载最上乘的内功秘要——小天星玄玉通真功，此神功阴阳调和，刚柔并济，一旦练成，内力自生速度奇快，似无穷尽。即使是平庸之极的一招，出手时也有莫大威力。

    每天半夜里，他就悄悄溜出堡去，在荒野里练拳练剑练刀。他用一柄木头削成的刀剑来练习，每刺出一剑，就想象着要刺入杀父仇人的胸膛；每砍出一刀，就想象着要砍去杀父仇人的脑袋。虽然，他并不知仇人到底是谁。但辉哥将来会说的，等他长大成人、武艺练好之后。

    于是他练得更加热切，想得更加深刻。秘籍中的难处，一项一项想明白了。因为，最上乘的武功是用脑子来思考的，而不单单是用手脚来练习的。

    这样过了七八个月，岳胜的伤早就痊愈了。温老太知道温宏伟虽一世英雄，但去世时儿子年幼，学不到多少万澜集团的高明武功，她知岳胜拳脚功夫了得，便留他教导温文新功夫。岳胜经恶斗曹虎一役后心灰意懒，只想及早退出江湖，好在半生奔波，略有积蓄，物流公司便暂不营业，眼见主人殷勤，也就住了下来。

    温文新没拜他为师，只因温老太有这么一股傲气，温宏伟家传绝艺，怎能去投外派师父？但岳胜感念他家护货的恩情，对温文新如同弟子一般看待，只要是自己会的，他想学什么就教什么，将拳技的精要倾囊以授。百胜拳的外号殊非幸致，拳术上确有独到造诣，这七八个月中温文新确实获益良多。

    岳胜也已看出来，温家堡并非卧虎藏龙另有高人，只是那日曹虎为何匆匆而去，却百思不得其解。有次他偶然把话题带到这件事上，温老太微微一笑，顾而言他。岳胜知主人不肯吐露，从此绝口不提。

    这日午后，闵嘉庚打扫了大厅和练武厅，溜出堡去，到后山林子里玩耍。他常于无人时在这里练习轻功，追兔逐犬，飞身捕鹊，掷石捉鸦，这时正玩得高兴，忽听温文新的声音说：“岳伯伯，那路通臂六合拳其中我还有好些不明白的，请您指点。”闵嘉庚忙钻入一棵柏树后的长草丛中，只听岳胜说：“好！小兵、青青，这路拳法你们是练熟了的，便拆给少堡主瞧瞧吧。”

    闵嘉庚从草丛中向外望出去，只见岳青脱下外套，紧了紧腰带，笑着说：“哥，请你手下留情。”周银兵嘻嘻一笑说：“好说，好说！干爸，我们拳脚生疏了，请您指点。”岳胜说：“常言说：拳不离手，曲不离口。学过的拳脚怎么可以生疏的？”周银兵应了声：“是！”向岳青一招手，跃入草场中间。

    岳青说：“拳招来啦！”左手轻轻一拳，周银兵举右手一架，岳青右臂倏地击向周银兵面门，拳头离他鼻子约有半尺。周银兵仰后相避。不料岳青的右臂突然似乎长了一尺，本来力道看来已尽，陡然间手臂不动，拳头疾伸，啪的一下，正中周银兵鼻旁脸颊。周银兵哎呦一声，跳开两步。岳青笑着说：“哎呦，对不起！”温文新拍手大笑，叫道：“好，好！通臂连拳果然了不起！”

    周银兵有心让义妹一招，好讨她欢喜，否则决不致连第一招最初步的通臂连拳也让不开，听温文新大声喝彩，见干爸板起了脸不作声，便即转身出拳，呼呼有风。兄妹这一交上了手，周银兵更不相让，毕竟他力大招沉，又多学了半年，岳青渐渐抵挡不住，避让稍迟，左肩上吃了一拳。她哎呀一声呼叫，周银兵微笑说：“对不起。”转头向温文新瞪眼相视，心想：“好小子，你瞧仔细了！”温文新侧头瞧着远处*，假装没瞧见他这招。

    岳胜说：“这通臂连拳嘛，最要紧的是要记得虚实之用。”走上来虚拟拳脚，口中说：“招数的名称当真过招时不用记着，记了也是没用。咱们说‘凤凰旋窝’、‘燕子掠水’什么的，只不过教招时有个名目，我说之后，你们知道我使的是哪招而已，当真动手，你用‘凤凰旋窝’把对手打倒，还是用‘燕子掠水’把对手打倒，半点也不相干。你心里记着招数，反而把虚实之用给忘了。你只要见到他左臂这么一沉，就知他右拳便要打过来。又要瞧他右腰，倘若并不当真使劲，他右拳这下便是虚的，真正实招却在左手，左手拳这下可就结结实实厉害得很了。你闪他的右手拳，往左一避，砰的一下，刚好凑上了他的左拳。通臂连拳双臂忽左忽右，两条手臂似乎串成了一起，倒像左臂可以连接到右臂上，有时右臂又可连接到左臂上。其实两条手臂如何可以互相连通，只是转换得快了，对手头晕眼花，分不出虚实而已。”

    周银兵与岳青对这路通臂连拳早就练得纯熟，岳胜将温文新叫过来，指点了拳招，着重解释虚实之道，连比带说，详细解明。
content_en:
Yue Qing saw that the beautiful woman looked exhausted and her eyes were red and swollen. She had encountered heavy rain on the way and it was very hard. She wore wet clothes and warmed herself by the fire. The moisture forced into her body, and she must have a serious illness.Now you have cloth clothes, please change them.After you dry your clothes, change them back."The beautiful woman was so grateful that she smiled at her and stood up. Her eyes seemed to be asking her husband. The man nodded and smiled at Yue Qing to express his gratitude. The beautiful woman took Yue Qing's hand, and the two women went to the back hall to borrow a room and change clothes.

The three police officers looked at each other with strange expressions on their faces, imagining how beautiful the young woman must be when she was changing her clothes.The police officer who had just quarreled with Zhou Yinbing was the boldest, and with an itchy heart, he whispered: "Let me take a look."Trying to take a peek. Another police officer smiled and said: "Xiaotian, don't be ridiculous."Xiaotian stood up, took a few steps, and with a change of heart, he picked up the single sword from the ground and hung it on his body.

Zhou Yinbing was humiliated by him and was always angry in his heart. When he saw him walking to the backyard, he turned around and saw Yue Sheng closing his eyes and concentrating. He also saw that the masters were guarding the truck to prevent any trouble, so he followed Xiaotian.

Xiaotian heard the sound of footsteps behind him, turned around, saw it was Zhou Yinbing, grinned and said: "Hello, silly boy!Zhou Yinbing refused to give in and said, "Hello, stinky officer!"Xiaotian asked with a smile: "You want to be beaten, don't you?"Zhou Yinbing said, "Yes."My godfather won’t let me hit you. Let’s have a quiet fight, okay?"

Xiaotian relied on his martial arts skills and didn't take this stupid boy seriously at all. He just saw that there were many people in his logistics company and he only had three people. If there was a group fight, he would definitely suffer.Since this stupid boy wanted to fight quietly here, it was the best, so he smiled and nodded and said: "Okay.Let's go further away. If your godfather hears this, this fight won't end."

The two of them walked through the courtyard, looking for a place where no one was around to start the attack.Suddenly, I saw a man coming out of the corridor. He was wearing a brocade robe and had beautiful features. He was the young man who had been practicing darts just now.Zhou Yinbing's heart moved and he thought to himself: "It would be best to use his martial arts training hall to fight.So he stepped forward, cupped his fists and said, "Please."The young man returned the salute and said, "My dear friend, what are your orders?"Zhou Yinbing pointed at Xiaotian and said, "I have a bit of a feud with this security guard, and I want to use my brother's martial arts training hall.""

The young man was so strange that he thought to himself: "How did you know that my home has a martial arts training hall?"But people who learn martial arts like it more than anything else when they hear others competing in martial arts. They immediately say: "Great!Excellent!"Leading the two of them into the martial arts training hall.

Xiaotian saw that there were all kinds of swords, guns, swords and halberds on the weapon racks on the four walls. In addition, sandbags, arrow targets, stone locks, and stone drums were placed all over the floor. There were also seventy-two plum blossom stakes installed in the ground at the west end. He nodded secretly and thought to himself: "It turns out that this family knows martial arts. I'm afraid they are pretty good at martial arts."He cupped his fists at the young man and said, "Come down here to take shelter from the rain. I haven't asked the master's name yet."The young man quickly returned the courtesy and said, "My little brother is Wen Wenxin."Please tell me the names of these two people.Zhou Yinbing rushed to say: "My name is Zhou Yinbing, and my godfather is the old boxer Yue Shengyue of Haian Logistics.""As he said that, he glared at Xiaotian, secretly proud, and thought to himself: "You heard the name of my godfather, you know how powerful he is."

Wen Wenxin cupped his hands and said, "I have admired you for a long time.Ask this one for advice.Oda said: "I work in Shimoda Xingchen and serve in the Police Department.""Wen Wenxin said: "It turns out to be Officer Tian, ​​disrespectful, disrespectful!"

Zhou Yinbing said loudly: "Young Lord, please do a notarization.I have a fair fight with this guy surnamed Tian. No matter who wins or loses, we are not allowed to tell anyone about it."He was afraid that his godfather would find out and scold him. Tian Xingchen laughed and said, "It's a big deal to beat a stupid young man like you. Is it worth showing off to others?Come on, come on."As he spoke, he smoothed out his coat, pulled up the corners, and stuffed it into his belt. Zhou Yinbing took off his coat and got into a fist-fighting posture, with his feet together and his hands clenching fists facing each other. He seemed calm and relaxed.

Tian Xingchen saw that his posture was the starting point for fighting with others from the Cha Quan sect, so he had already put his mind down and thought to himself: "This three-year-old Zha Quan boy can do it, what's so strange about it?"It turns out that Tan, Cha, Hua, and Hong Xiang are called the "Four Great Masters of Northern Boxing," referring to the four schools of boxing, Tan Kou, Zha Boxing, Hua Boxing, and Hong She. They are widely spread in the north. Anyone who practices boxing knows a little bit about it, and it can be regarded as an introductory skill in boxing. When Tian Xingchen saw that his opponent's boxing skills were ordinary, he smiled at Wen Wenxin and said, "Show your embarrassment!"Hit Zhou Yinbing with a move of "Step up to part the mane of a wild horse". He was using Tai Chi. At that time, Tai Chi sect's martial arts was very popular, and everyone knew that it was an extremely powerful internal martial art.

Zhou Yinbing did not dare to neglect. He stepped back with his left foot, turned his upper body into a sitting position, pressed with his right hand, and lifted with his left hand. He performed a "backstep and palm lift" move, which was very fast.Tian Xingchen saw that the attack was not weak, so he quickly used the move "turn around and carry the tiger back to the mountain" to avoid this move.Zhou Yinbing used the "Lunge Fight" move, punched out his right fist with a roar, and rushed straight to the opponent's front door.Tian Xingchen couldn't avoid it, so he made the move "like a seal" with both palms.The two fists met, Tian Xingchen felt a faint pain in his wrist, and thought to himself: "This stupid young man has great brute strength!"

In an instant, the two of them showed off their fists and executed more than ten moves.Wen Wenxin stood and watched, seeing Zhou Yinbing's steady steps and powerful punches.However, Tian Xingchen's figure was erratic. It was obvious that he had a good foundation in Qinggong. He used Tai Chi, but his hands and feet were very fast.

When the fight reached its peak, Tian Xingchen laughed and hit Zhou Yinbing on the shoulder with his palm.Zhou Yinbing kicked him away, but Tian Xingchen dodged sideways and used the "Jade Girl Shuttle" move, which hit Zhou Yinbing's arm again with a snap.Zhou Yinbing paid no attention to him, and attacked quickly with his fists. He suddenly punched straight out and hit Nakata Xingchen in the chest with a "Lung Step" move.The punch was so heavy that Tian Xingchen staggered, took a few steps back, and finally fell down.I heard a woman's voice next to me saying softly: "Okay!"

Wen Wenxin turned around and saw two women standing at the door of the hall, one was a beautiful woman and the other was a girl.He had been watching the battle intently, unaware that there was someone behind him.It turned out that Yue Qing and the beautiful woman had changed their clothes and passed by. When they heard the shouts of a martial arts competition, they looked at the door and saw that it was the sworn brother fighting with the soldiers. When he saw the sworn brother winning, he couldn't help but cheer.

Tian Xingchen felt so much pain from the punch that he was embarrassed in front of the woman. He became even more angry and jumped up. Taking advantage of the momentum of the jump, he already held a single sword in his hand and stepped forward to strike straight.Zhou Yinbing was not afraid and still fought him with his bare hands, but he was afraid of the sharpness of his opponent's weapons, so he dodged more and attacked less.Yue Qing couldn't help but feel worried when he saw that the police officer had a ferocious look on his face, that he was fighting unusually, as if he was desperately fighting.

The beautiful woman pulled her sleeves and said, "Let's go.What I hate most is when people start fighting."Under this situation, Yue Qing was not willing to leave and said: "Watch for a while."The beautiful woman frowned and walked away.

Wen Wenxin watched Tian Xingchen's sword skills attentively, and also carefully observed Zhou Yinbing's way of dodging and attacking. He secretly held a money dart in his hand. If Tian Xingchen hurt someone with a knife, he had no choice but to save him.

But Zhou Yinbing's eyes were fixed on the blade. When the blade was facing east, his eyes followed him to the east. When the blade pointed to the west, his eyes followed him to the west.But seeing a knife coming towards him, he dodged slightly and kicked his opponent on the wrist.Tian Xingchen slashed his feet with the knife, Zhou Yinbing stretched out his long arm, and with a bang, he punched Tian Xingchen on the bridge of his nose.Tian Xingchen was in great pain, and his hands and feet slowed down slightly. Zhou Yinbing swung out his left hand, grabbed his right wrist, twisted it, and snatched the single sword away.

Tian Xingchen was afraid that he would slash with the knife, so he jumped back quickly, raised his hand and wiped it on his face, his hand was covered with blood.Zhou Yinbing threw his single sword to the ground and asked: "Do you still dare to curse others blindly?"Tian Xingchen was ashamed and did not dare to say anything. Wen Wenxin stepped forward and pulled Zhou Yinbing's collar and winked. Zhou Yinbing had not yet understood. Wen Wenxin said loudly: "There is no winner or loser between the two sides.Okay, these two brothers are both very good at martial arts, I admire you very much..." Zhou Yinbing shouted: "Why...how can there be no distinction between victory and defeat?"Wen Wenxin said: "Both two have their own merits in martial arts.Brother Zhou is proficient in Cha Quan, and Officer Tian is even more powerful in Tai Chi and Tai Chi Knife.Brother Zhou, you were lucky for a moment, but in fact, in terms of real skills, you have to count on Officer Tian."As he said that, he took out a towel to wipe Tian Xingchen's nosebleed. Zhou Yinbing wanted to fight again, and Yue Qing said angrily: "Brother, ignore them!Let's go."

Zhou Yinbing punched Tian Xingchen twice, and he was already angry. However, the notary spoke vaguely and clearly protected the other party. It seemed that he had lost. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. He glared at him fiercely and walked out.When he walked to the patio, thunder rumbled in the sky. The thunder was accompanied by the laughter of Wen Wenxin and Tian Xingchen. It was obvious that these two people were still laughing at him behind his back.

Although he won, the more he thought about it, the more unhappy he became, and he sat by the fire angrily.Yue Sheng's eyes seemed to be open and closed, and he was very sleepy.After a while, Tian Xingchen came out and said some obscene words to the two police officers. The three of them laughed together and glanced sideways at the beautiful young woman from time to time.
